_doc: NINTH HELD-OUT real project (Phase 4 final measurement), the second real C# one: NModbus (samples/realworld/nmodbus, ~13.9K lines of C#; industrial Modbus RTU/ASCII/TCP/UDP master and slave library, shipped tree incl. unit and integration tests). Questions written from facts verified in the source AFTER all Phase 4 fixes and BEFORE Verity was ever run on it. First runs kept in bench/results/realworld_heldout9/first-run-*.

cases.q: What happens when the slave answers that it is busy?
What happens when the slave responds with an ACKNOWLEDGE exception?
What happens when a response has an unexpected function code?
What happens when the response comes from a different slave address?
What happens when a request times out?
What happens when a response has a bad checksum?
What happens when WaitToRetryMilliseconds is set to a negative value?
How does the transport decide that a response is a slave exception?
Where is the number of retries set?
